description: Confuses photosynthesis with absence of cellular respiration.
positive_cues: plants do not respire|only animals respire
negative_cues: it is false that plants do not respire|plants do respire

canonical_statement: Plants obtain their food directly from soil.
description: Treats minerals and water uptake as the source of plant carbohydrate.
positive_cues: plants get food from soil|plants absorb food from soil
negative_cues: plants make food through photosynthesis|plants make glucose
remediation: Contrast mineral uptake with carbohydrate production.

canonical_statement: A force is required to keep an object moving at constant velocity.
description: Confuses force with maintenance of motion rather than change in velocity.
positive_cues: force keeps an object moving|needs force to keep moving
negative_cues: constant velocity does not require net force|no net force is needed to keep moving
remediation: Contrast maintaining velocity with changing velocity.

canonical_statement: A larger denominator means a larger unit fraction.
description: Compares denominator numerals rather than piece size.
positive_cues: larger denominator means larger fraction|one fifth is bigger than one third
negative_cues: one third is bigger than one fifth|larger denominator makes smaller pieces
remediation: Use equal-whole visual comparison of unit fractions.

description: Treats statistical association as sufficient evidence of a causal effect.
negative_cues: correlation does not prove causation|association is not causation
remediation: Separate association language from causal claims.

canonical_statement: A while loop always executes at least once.
description: Confuses pre-test while loops with post-test loop behavior.
positive_cues: while loop always runs once|while executes at least once
negative_cues: while loop can run zero times|condition is checked before the loop
remediation: Trace the condition before the first iteration.

canonical_statement: After a long run of heads tails becomes more likely on the next fair flip.
description: Applies the gambler's fallacy to independent events.
positive_cues: tails is due after many heads|tails becomes more likely after heads
negative_cues: each fair flip stays independent|next flip is still one half
remediation: Separate long-run frequency intuition from the next independent trial.

canonical_statement: Temperature directly measures total heat energy.
description: Conflates temperature with total thermal energy.
positive_cues: temperature measures total heat|hotter object has more total heat
negative_cues: temperature is not total thermal energy|thermal energy depends on amount of matter
remediation: Compare objects with different masses and temperatures.
